query: When encoding two AIs in one GS1-128 barcode, when do I need to put a field separator between them?
expected_answer: FNC1, entered with the escape sequence \F, is needed after a variable length field such as batch number AI 10, whereas fixed length AI 01 needs no separator. Translate Escape Sequences must be activated to encode it.
expected_facts: AI 01 is fixed length so no FNC1
Translate Escape Sequences must be activated

relevant_passages.quote: ► Because AI 01 is a fixed length data field, no FNC1 (field separator) is used.
► The field separator FNC1 (encoded by the sequence „\F“) has to be used because the batch number (AI 10) is a variable length data field.
► For encoding the FNC1, you have to activate Translate Escape Sequences.

query: Why can't the Code 128 check digit be left out, and does it show in the human readable text?
expected_answer: Code128 uses a built-in Modulo 103 check digit that is part of the code and cannot be omitted. It is never printed in the human readable text, and scanners check it but do not deliver it to connected systems.
expected_facts: part of the code and cannot be omitted
never printed in the human readable text
scanners do not deliver it to connected systems

relevant_passages.quote: Code128 uses a built-in check digit (Modulo 103). This check digit is part of the code and cannot be omitted. It is never printed in the human readable text.
